summary: Military air exercise with high energy manoeuvres near Ingleby Greenhow, North Yorkshire, up to 9,000 feet above sea level within 5 nautical miles.
text:
AIR EXER. WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES IN SUPPORT OF
GROUND OPS WI 5NM RADIUS OF 542622N 0010642W (INGLEBY GREENHOW,
NORTH YORKSHIRE). ACFT MAY OPERATE AT SPEEDS OF UP TO 450 KNOTS
IAS AND MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR FURTHER INFO AIC
Y007/2023 REFERS. OPS CTC FREQ 271.400MHZ FOR INFO 07972 78428.
AR-2026-11175/01.
